terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The rules and expectations for using Kieio.
terms.placeholderNotice: ⚠️ Placeholder · final terms pending lawyer review for HK + TW jurisdictions.
terms.section1Body: Kieio (operated at kieio.com) provides AI-driven interactive fiction. We generate narratives using third-party language models (Anthropic · OpenAI · Google · Meta via OpenRouter) based on prompts you submit. Output is fictional and not advice.
terms.section2Body: You must be 13 or older to create an account. Adult mode (NSFW content) requires identity verification confirming you are 18 or older via Stripe Identity. We may suspend accounts for violations of community standards or applicable law.
terms.section3Body: You agree not to: (a) generate or share content involving minors in sexual situations (CSAM · pre-filtered + reported to authorities), (b) generate content depicting real persons without consent, (c) reverse-engineer or scrape our LLM outputs at scale, (d) use the platform for harassment, doxxing, or illegal activity.
terms.section4Body: Subscriptions billed monthly via Stripe. Credits granted upon successful payment (Standard $9.99 / Pro $19.99 USD). Refunds at our discretion within 14 days of purchase. Top-up purchases are non-refundable. See Pricing page for current rates.
terms.section5Body: Service provided as-is. We are not liable for AI-generated content, user-uploaded content, or indirect damages. We may terminate accounts at our discretion. Your data export rights are described in our Privacy Policy.
terms.lastUpdated: Last updated: {date} · contact legal@kieio.com for questions

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: What we collect, why we collect it, and your controls.
privacy.placeholderNotice: ⚠️ Placeholder · final privacy policy pending lawyer review for PCPD (HK) + PIPL (TW) compliance.
privacy.section1Body: Account: email, display name (from OAuth provider or you), language preference. Gameplay: stories, playthroughs, characters, memory, credit ledger. Operational: IP, user agent, error reports (Sentry), product analytics (PostHog) — all linked to your user ID.
privacy.section2Body: We process data through: Supabase (database + auth · US-East), Vercel (hosting · global edge), Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / OpenRouter (LLM inference), Stripe (payments · global), Sentry (errors), PostHog (analytics). LLM prompts are sent to the model provider only · we do not train models on your content.
privacy.section3Body: Adult mode requires age verification via Stripe Identity (selfie + ID). Verification metadata (verified yes/no · timestamp) is retained; the selfie + ID images are processed by Stripe and not stored by us. Adult mode content is generated using NSFW-friendly providers (OpenRouter) isolated from default LLMs.
privacy.section4Body: You can: export your data (contact privacy@kieio.com), delete your account (settings → delete · cascades to playthroughs + memory), opt out of analytics (PostHog respects DNT header). Data retention: account data kept until deletion; error logs 90 days; analytics 12 months.
privacy.section5Body: Data controller: Kieio (HK-based). Disputes governed by HK law. Contact privacy@kieio.com for data access / deletion / corrections. PCPD (HK) and PIPL (TW) data subject rights apply.
privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: {date} · contact privacy@kieio.com for questions

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Cookies we set and why they're needed.
cookies.placeholderNotice: ⚠️ Placeholder · final cookie disclosure pending lawyer review.
cookies.section1Body: Supabase auth session (httpOnly · scoped to .kieio.com) · next-intl locale preference (NEXT_LOCALE) · Vercel deployment routing (vercel-id). These are required for the site to function · you can't opt out.
cookies.section2Body: PostHog sets a distinct_id cookie to track activation funnel (signup · first turn · subscribe). We do not link this to ad networks · we do not sell data to third parties.
cookies.section3Body: Sentry session ID for grouping errors to a single browser session. Disabled in development · production-only.
cookies.section4Body: Set Do-Not-Track in your browser · PostHog honors it. Clear cookies via your browser settings to reset analytics distinct_id. Essential cookies cannot be opted out without breaking auth.
cookies.lastUpdated: Last updated: {date} · contact privacy@kieio.com for questions
